name: Cradle of the Seal
description: The underground complex built around the First Seal — a massive warding construct spanning a natural rift in the earth. The Wardens carved their greatest achievement into living rock, layer upon layer of containment magic protecting the world from what lies beneath. The seal still holds, but barely. Cracks run through the ward-lines, and the golden light that once burned steadily now flickers and surges unpredictably.

rooms.name: The Descent
rooms.description: A spiral staircase carved from a single column of granite, descending deep into the rift. The warding glyphs on the walls grow brighter as you descend — the seal's power concentrates here, pressed into the stone like light into crystal. Each step echoes in the vertical shaft, the sound swallowed by the vast darkness below.

rooms.description: A circular corridor following the outer wall of the Cradle. The ceiling is low, the air close and warm. Ward-lines run along the floor in channels of hammered brass, still conducting faint golden energy. Doorways lead inward toward the seal chamber, but the wards here are the first line of defense — and they are cracking.

Six pillars ring a central altar of polished obsidian, each pillar connected to the altar by channels of brass filled with slowly pulsing golden light. The altar's surface is carved with a complex interlocking pattern — a focusing lens for the seal's power.

rooms.name: Seal Gallery
rooms.description: The walls of this long chamber are carved with murals depicting the creation of the First Seal. Panel by panel, the story unfolds: the discovery of the entity, the convening of the Warden Council, the months of ritual preparation, and finally the sealing itself — thirty Wardens giving their lives to bind the entity for eternity. The final panel shows a single figure remaining to watch over the seal. The paint is faded, but the golden leaf still catches the light.

rooms.name: Guardian Hall
rooms.description: A vast hall at the heart of the Cradle, its vaulted ceiling lost in shadow. The floor is a single massive warding circle, fifty feet across, its brass and obsidian lines still glowing with fierce golden light. This is where the seal's guardian dwells — the last and most powerful defense before the seal itself. The air thrums with concentrated warding energy.

rooms.name: Seal Antechamber
rooms.description: The final chamber before the seal itself. A great door of warded bronze blocks the way south — the last physical barrier. Its surface is covered in thousands of individual glyphs, each one a separate binding. A speaking-horn is set into the door at eye level, and an inscription above reads: 'Only those who understand the cost may pass.'

interactables.description: The speaking-horn awaits your answer. The inscription reads: 'Only those who understand the cost may pass.'

actionData.question: I bind the strong, I silence the mighty, I hold what cannot be held. Thirty gave everything to create me, and one remains to ensure I endure. What am I?
actionData.hint: Taren's notes describe the thirty Wardens who sacrificed themselves to create the binding, and the single keeper who stayed behind.
actionData.successMessage: The speaking-horn echoes your answer through the door. One by one, the thousands of glyphs flare to brilliant life and then dim, the bindings acknowledging your understanding. The great bronze door swings inward with the weight of ages, revealing the First Seal beyond.
actionData.failureMessage: The speaking-horn falls silent. The glyphs on the door pulse once — a warning — and then return to their steady glow. The door does not open.

interactables.description: The floor before the door shimmers with concentrated energy.

actionData.noticeMessage: The threshold ward is active — you can see the trigger-lines in the floor tiles.

actionData.saveMessage: You leap back as the ward fires, the energy barrier passing inches from your face.
actionData.failMessage: The ward-barrier catches you full force, golden energy burning through your defenses.

rooms.name: The First Seal
rooms.description: The chamber of the First Seal. The rift in the earth yawns open here, a chasm a hundred feet across, and the seal spans it — a web of golden light so intricate and beautiful that it takes your breath away. Millions of ward-lines intersect in perfect geometric harmony, containing something vast and dark that presses against them from below. Cracks are visible now, thin lines of darkness in the golden web. The seal is failing. At the chamber's center, a stone platform overlooks the seal, and here the Guardian waits.

npcs.name: The First Seal-Guardian
npcs.description: The ultimate protector of the First Seal — a being of pure warding energy given form. It appears as a towering humanoid figure of golden light, its features abstract and shifting, its eyes twin suns of concentrated power. It is the seal made manifest, the living embodiment of the thirty Wardens who sacrificed themselves to create it. It does not speak. It does not negotiate. It exists to protect, and it will destroy anything it perceives as a threat to the containment — including you.
